symptom: `import from source query 'SELECT name, friend FROM later' into MyFirstModule.Person map (name as Name) link (friend to Person_Friend on Name)` through a self-Reference stored as a table failed: junction table INSERT … column "myfirstmodule$personid" of relation "myfirstmodule$person_friend" does not exist (SQLSTATE 42703).
file: sql/import_assoc.go JunctionColumns + LookupAssociationInfo (now reads parent_column_name); mdl/executor/cmd_import.go resolveOneLink. Test: sql/import_assoc_self_1686_test.go
cause: Both junction column names were derived from the entity by convention ({module}${entity}id), identical for a self-association; mendixsystem$association's parent_column_name/child_column_name were not read for table storage.
insight: **Measure the junction table, then read the system row rather than re-deriving it**: on 11.12.6 Person_Friend (Person to Person, table) is myfirstmodule$personid1 (parent) / personid2 (child), and mendixsystem$association records exactly that. A control run of the unfixed build on the same database is what showed the failure is real (the issue had only been read off the code). IMPORT LINK accepts Reference only, so a ReferenceSet repro stops earlier.
